verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator, with a PCIe/OAM card and a software stack for running your own PyTorch training and inference on your own infrastructure. It is not a hosted AI service that collects user data. A data-training opt-out control is therefore a category error for this product type. The evidence only shows on-premise and cloud acceleration of user-run workloads, with no vendor-side data collection that would make an opt-out applicable.
